t: You're at the Royal National Theatre, on the South Bank of the Thames in Lambeth. It was designed by Sir Denys Lasdun, an English architect hailed as the greatest of the early heroic modern period. This is his best-known work, and it's Grade II star listed. It's regarded as one of the most notable examples of Brutalist design in the United Kingdom, so take a moment to look at the way the concrete forms are layered and stacked.
